title: Gespaltenes Inselmonument A
description: Monumentales 40-m-Inselmonument (~33 × 23 × 40 m) auf dreistufig abgetreppter runder Kalksteinplattform mit architektonischem Sattelsockel, zwei exakt gefasten Scheiben-Hälften und geschichteter Bruchfuge. Palette monument_white / monument_weathered / monument_shadow, 2 m Eingrabe-Rand.

review.notes: Approved (R13): Rebuilt 33.0x24.6x42.1m (-2.0m skirt) split disc resolves all R6-R12 blockers. Full 3D staggered curved plinth ashlars + bevelled saddle cradle, 28 continuous rim voussoirs with zero black leaks, complete tapered face ashlars across all 15 courses with no missing perimeter slices, and organic triangulated rock-strata cleft. Matte sunlit ivory/cream limestone, cool shadows, and damp plinth patina match gate_white_a and monument_rib_crown_a; 1.8m figure anchors monumental scale; clean 29,868-tri mesh. Non-blocking polish: 2-3 cleft overhang triangles in closeup_upper read slightly sharp/sawtoothed.
